body:
## Why
KB_TOKEN is a fine-grained PAT with a deliberate 30-day expiry (security posture). When it lapses the Actions dispatcher degrades gracefully but silently-ish; the operator should hear about it a week early, not at expiry.

## What
GitHub returns the `github-authentication-token-expiration` response header on API calls made with a fine-grained PAT. In `hkb doctor` (and once per day in the loop): when running with a token that has that header, surface the expiry date; warn at <7 days ("mint a new PAT and gh secret set KB_TOKEN"), fail the check at expired. In Actions, emit it as a `::warning::` so it shows on the run. No header (OAuth/classic token) → silent.
title: doctor: warn when KB_TOKEN is close to expiry
